responsibility: Declares the compiler-wide interned-name table used by gm2 to convert strings into stable numeric keys. It defines the `Name` type and operations for interning from Modula-2 or C strings, recovering text, testing membership, comparing keys case-insensitively, writing keys, indexing characters, and obtaining raw C-string pointers, making it the canonical symbol-name interning interface used throughout the frontend.
same_name_distinction: This is the public interface for the NameKey stem: it declares the abstract Name key type and interning/query operations, while NameKey.mod contains the storage structures and algorithms behind that API.
